$schema_note: Copy this file to your project as .preflight/config.json and edit for your project.
_comment_rubric: Path (string) or paths (array) to review rubrics. Array form enables multi-rubric modes: ["rubric-api-design.md", "rubric-generic.md"]. If omitted, plugin defaults are used based on mode.
_comment_capture: Paths for the self-improvement capture files. Created on first use.
_comment_branch: base = the protected target branch; remote = the intended push target. *** VERIFY 'remote' BEFORE ANY PUSH ***: the pre-push guard treats branch.remote as the INTENDED target and does NOT block a push to it, so if your repo's 'origin' (the default below) is a LEGACY/PRODUCTION repo, leaving remote='origin' points the push pipeline at PROD. This is exactly the SessionToken inversion (committed remote=origin while origin was legacy prod). ON SETUP: (1) confirm 'origin' is the repo you intend to push to; if not, set 'remote' correctly; (2) if 'origin' (or any remote) must NEVER be pushed to, add it to forbiddenRemotes/forbiddenRepos, the denylist the guard checks the RESOLVED target against REGARDLESS of 'remote'. forbiddenRemotes = remote NAMES; forbiddenRepos = owner/repo slugs or full URLs. The guard ALSO blocks a bare 'git push' (no named remote) when push-gating is opted in, because a bare push's default target is unvalidatable. Guard is agent-Bash-tool-only and fail-open (empty lists = inert; no config = no gating), NOT server-side protection. PER-CLONE OVERRIDE: if THIS clone's topology differs from the committed values, do NOT edit this committed file; create a gitignored .preflight/config.local.json with only the topology keys (branch.remote/base/migrationPrefix, migration.*). Gate thresholds, loop/review policy, rubric, and the forbidden lists are NOT overridable locally (see lib/config-overlay.sh).

branch._comment_remote_VERIFY: DEFAULT is 'origin'. CONFIRM this is your intended push target, NOT a legacy/prod repo, before the pipeline pushes. If origin is prod: change this, or add origin to forbiddenRemotes below.

test._comment: Command to run tests. Auto-detected if null (dotnet test for .NET, npm test for Node).
test._comment_coverageBaseline: null = no hard numeric gate pinned in config; during migration runs the migrate skill applies its documented 85% fallback floor (Check 5). Set an explicit number (e.g. 96.0) to pin the gate for your team. Lowering a configured baseline is a reviewed change — and NOT overridable via config.local.json (the overlay allowlist in lib/config-overlay.sh excludes test.*).
